summary: The structured-route guide says the live writer assigns revision and digest, but delivery-route record validates the submitted revision and digest before posting.
evidence: command:fsgg-coord delivery-route record FS-GG/FS.GG.Governance#413 route.json --json first refused revision 0/empty digest; source:FS.GG.Coord.Cli/Client.fs validates candidate ledger before posting
cost: one refused write and one manual digest calculation

summary: Packing once per run does not preserve byte identity across a partial-publication retry; --skip-duplicate can retain prior org-feed bytes while a fresh repack is sent to NuGet.org.
evidence: review:https://github.com/FS-GG/FS.GG.Governance/pull/415#issuecomment-5310559547; run:https://github.com/FS-GG/FS.GG.Governance/actions/runs/31982087539 left SPI 0.1.0 accepted by the org feed before public publication failed
cost: one changes-required review round and an org-authoritative package retrieval repair
